name: GARKATRON
bio: Empecé a programar durante la pandemia y desde entonces no he parado. Tengo experiencia en desarrollo web y multiplataforma, me enfoco en proyectos escalables organizados y eficientes, me intereso en explorar herramientas alternativas.
bio_en: I started programming during the pandemic and haven't stopped since. I have experience in web and cross-platform development; I focus on scalable, organized, and efficient projects, and I am interested in exploring alternative tools.
_audioProvider_comment: Which audio provider the player uses: 'soundcloud' or 'spotify'. Both ship in src/lib/audio/; the other stays available as a fallback.
